title: Routing Email AI Tasks: Test Each Provider Before Scaling
author: Stefan Bogdanescu
excerpt: Subject-line drafting and bounce classification need different evaluations. For drafting, check factual accuracy, tone and required fields. For classification, use labeled examples, including ambiguous cases. Do not choose solely from parameter counts.
content:
Match the task to a test

Subject-line drafting and bounce classification need different evaluations. For drafting, check factual accuracy, tone and required fields. For classification, use labeled examples, including ambiguous cases. Do not choose solely from parameter counts.

Use provider selection carefully

Laravel Mail's agent infrastructure includes provider and model selection. That is a basis for experiments, not proof that every task works with every model. Test output format, tool behavior, timeouts and failure handling for each route.

Make fallback visible

A failed local request should not silently cross a privacy boundary. Decide whether the task can wait, go to human review, or use an approved alternate provider. Record the choice in operational logs without storing unnecessary subscriber data.

Budget for capacity

Ollama documents concurrency and memory constraints. Measure queue delay as well as generation speed. A small model can be a useful choice, but neither quality nor savings is guaranteed until the actual workload has been tested.

Sources and scope

Configuration and test results determine the behavior of an individual installation. This guide does not certify a live deployment or promise a cost, deliverability or compliance result.
